notes.title: Chet Faliszek Played Holy Journey of Salvation!
notes.content:
Chet Faliszek was kind enough to play my game. 
He talks out loud about his thoughts of the game, and partakes in a Holy Journey-to reach Salvation! 


FULL LIVESTREAM:
https://www.youtube.com/live/_0miOPHP4pU?si=H3ceR-IX23w3fDYr


Precursory Video:
[previewyoutube=5qgp86iaDRo;full][/previewyoutube]


Make sure to check out Chet's YouTube Channel, and his game [u][b]The Anacrusis[/b][/u] whilst you're there! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120480/The_Anacrusis/
Chet's game is a Spiritual Successor to Left 4 Dead.

notes.title: Watch the devlogs for Holy Journey of Salvation
notes.content:
Dear Holy Journey of Salvation community,

It's hislittlecuzin; I thought you might be interested in seeing the development of Holy Journey of Salvation, so today I took all the development logs and put them into a complete YouTube playlist. 

I'm excited to share that experience with you. You can even see what I've been up to lately. /

[previewyoutube=Sz6ZtQ7ElXE;full][/previewyoutube]

Full playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTZZNkhP2rgiLl5Hjma-yjrp3ZcVrwbpn


Thank you for your interest in my first solo-released Steam game. 

Sincerely,
hislittlecuzin
